headline: 13 major public sector stocks drop to 52-week lows
summary: Thirteen CPSE stocks, including ONGC, NTPC, and BEL, touched 52-week lows during Thursday's intraday trading. Other affected companies include Power Grid, NMDC, IREDA, IRFC, RCF, RVNL, SJVN, and Mazagon Dock Shipbuilders. This broad decline reflects a significant cooling in investor sentiment toward the public sector space. The sell-off spans across energy, power, defense, and railway infrastructure sectors.
why_it_matters: PSU portfolio valuations face significant downward pressure

headline: Government to re-evaluate fixed-cost payments for urea manufacturers
hook: Urea subsidy framework faces first review since 2003
summary: The government is forming a sub-committee to review the fixed-cost payment structure for urea producers. The current formula has remained unchanged since the 2002-03 financial year, despite significant increases in production costs. This review could lead to a revision of the subsidy payout framework for the fertilizer sector. The outcome will directly influence the financial margins of domestic urea manufacturers.
whats_next: Sub-committee report and subsequent cabinet approval
why_it_matters: Fertilizer company margins may shift based on new subsidy formulas
winners_losers: Fertilizer producers gain / Government fiscal burden increases

headline: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers submits credit rating details to exchanges
summary: Rashtriya Chemicals and Fertilizers Limited has submitted a notification to the stock exchanges regarding a credit rating update. The filing pertains to its credit ratings assigned by rating agencies. No details of a rating upgrade or downgrade were disclosed in the headline filing. Retail investors holding the stock should note this as a standard corporate compliance update.
why_it_matters: Standard regulatory filing with no immediate financial impact.
